notes: Pages 1-3 hold the Form 14a item list (79 items, no office grouping, subtotals or grand total). Page 4 (printed sideways) is the Form 14b summary by office, transcribed as table summaryByOffice. No grand total is printed, so summary.total is null.

Item totals summed per PMO/End-User match every printed office total on the summary page (CSWDO = CSWDO-OSCA + CSWDO-PDAO; City Engineer's Office includes the one row whose end-user is printed "City Engineering Office").

Schedule cells are copied as printed: "various dates", dates as M/D/YYYY text, "on-going", and a printed dash/long dash recorded as "-"; empty cells are null. Some dates look inconsistent on the form (e.g. the first item's advertisement date 7/17/2026 precedes a 8/4/2025 notice of award; the Ambulatory Surgical Clinic row shows advertisement 12/5/2025 but bid opening 10/14/2025); transcribed as printed.
Region/Province/City fields are blank on the Form 14a pages; the summary page reads VII / CEBU / LAPU-LAPU CITY.
